AsianetMovies.in.title: Mangalam Nerunnu
AsianetMovies.in.desc: Menon, who is about to get married, is shocked to learn that his fiancée is in love with someone else. His life takes a turn when he leaves the village and meets a woman who is a prostitute.

AsianetMovies.in.title: Rain Rain Come Again
AsianetMovies.in.desc: A fierce college rivalry turns deadly when one group embrace Satanism, unleashing terror by killing their rivals one by one.

AsianetMovies.in.title: Amarkalam
AsianetMovies.in.desc: Vasu, an unruly man, fights with Mohana, the daughter of a police officer, over a movie reel. Thereafter, the two fall in love but face unforeseen problems while they try to unite.

AsianetMovies.in.title: Kancheepurathe Kalyanam
AsianetMovies.in.desc: Kalarikkal Achuthankutty and Pattarumatathil Najeeb are best friends and run an event management company. But soon they part ways because Najeeb secretly marries Achuthankutty's sister Athira.

AsianetMovies.in.title: Love 24x7
AsianetMovies.in.desc: Roopesh, a media executive, falls in love with Kabani, a trainee who works her way up to become a news presenter. A set of unforeseen events changes their personal and professional lives.

AsianetMovies.in.title: Oru Maravathoor Kanavu
AsianetMovies.in.desc: Michael and his family buy a farm that is coveted by a rich man, who makes life difficult for him. Thereafter, Michael's brother, Chandy, comes to support him.

AsianetMovies.in.title: Metro City
AsianetMovies.in.desc: After moving to Chennai, four individuals cross paths while chasing success in the city. However, when a ruthless gangster threatens them, they join forces to take him down.

AsianetMovies.in.title: Rappakal
AsianetMovies.in.desc: Saraswathiyamma is the head of a noble family that treats her servant Krishnan as one of her own sons. When her relatives conspire to sell her house, she and Krishnan set out to save it.

AsianetMovies.in.title: Bada Dosth
AsianetMovies.in.desc: A police officer befriends a lethal criminal though he has other plans for him.

AsianetMovies.in.title: Revathikkoru Pavakkutty
AsianetMovies.in.desc: When Revathi's father wishes to see her when he's on his deathbed, she refuses to go as her mother taught her that he's a bad man. So her friend who's an orphan visits in place of her.

AsianetMovies.in.title: Boyy Friennd
AsianetMovies.in.desc: Ramesh's mother files a case against the home minister for molesting her. After a few days, the minister is found dead and people suspect Ramesh of murdering him.

AsianetMovies.in.title: Chattakkari
AsianetMovies.in.desc: Julie, an Anglo-Indian girl, falls in love with Sasi, who is from a Hindu family. However, her life takes a turn for the worse when she gets pregnant with his child.

AsianetMovies.in.title: Meri Awas Suno
AsianetMovies.in.desc: After a radio jockey loses his voice due to excessive smoking, he walks on a difficult path to regain it by correcting his mistakes.

AsianetMovies.in.title: Pokkiri Simon
AsianetMovies.in.desc: Simon, an ardent Vijay fan, along with his friends, crosses paths with Arjunan and his brother who are petty criminals. Later, he decides to fight Arjunan and end his reign in the city.

AsianetPlus.in.title: Prabhatha Sandhya
AsianetPlus.in.desc: Usha, a foreign-returned woman, falls in love with Balan, a poor school teacher. However, her family opposes their union and wants her to marry her cousin Thampi.

AsianetPlus.in.title: Mattoral
AsianetPlus.in.desc: Susheela deserts her children and husband, Kaimal, to begin a new life with Giri. On learning this, Kaimal's friend, Balan, tries to reconcile them.

AsianetPlus.in.title: Out of Syllabus
AsianetPlus.in.desc: When village boy Gopikrishnan goes to study in a city college, he is bullied by his classmates. Namitha supports him through his difficult phase and they develop a close bond.

AsianetPlus.in.title: Kinnari Puzhayoram
AsianetPlus.in.desc: A father chooses the richer of two brothers as a suitor for his daughter. Filled with anger, the spurned brother acts like a holy man, which changes all their lives unexpectedly.

AsianetPlus.in.title: Parallel College
AsianetPlus.in.desc: To take his mind off of his dead lover, Ananthan accepts the position of a college professor. Soon, his life changes for the better and he finds solace in Sridevi's company.

AsianetPlus.in.title: Kuttettan
AsianetPlus.in.desc: Although married, Vishnu is a habitual flirt and always looks out for an affair. When he is almost caught with a young girl in his house, he lies to his family that she is his illegitimate daughter.

AsianetPlus.in.title: Hariharan Pillai Happy Aanu
AsianetPlus.in.desc: Hariharan, a builder, constructs a house for a wealthy man, who does not pay him. However, chaos ensues when he falls in love with the man's daughter.

AsianetPlus.in.title: Nanma Niranjavan Sreenivasan
AsianetPlus.in.desc: Sreenivasan, a simple villager, is passionate about local theatre and hanging out with his friends. His life takes a turn when he applies for a job in the police department.

AsianetPlus.in.title: Maniyarayile Ashokan
AsianetPlus.in.desc: Ashokan desperately wishes to get married as he is past the marriageable age. However, bad luck and a series of unfortunate circumstances threaten to make this a distant dream.

AsianetPlus.in.title: Finger Print
AsianetPlus.in.desc: A patriarch of a royal family goes on a mission to find the murderers responsible for killing his descendant. He takes the help of his nephews who are police officers.

AsianetPlus.in.title: Pooram
AsianetPlus.in.desc: A man's life takes a turn for the better when he is chosen as an actor while working as an assistant at a theatre troupe.

AsianetPlus.in.title: Malayali
AsianetPlus.in.desc: Madhavan is loved and respected by everyone in the village except his brothers who hate him. Matters get worse after his brothers try to falsely implicate him in an acquaintance's murder case.

AsianetPlus.in.title: Maratha Nadu
AsianetPlus.in.desc: Religious intolerance in a small faction results in a communal riot. A Muslim father is torn apart when his daughter requests him to marry her off to her Hindu lover.

AsianetPlus.in.title: Maharaja Talkies
AsianetPlus.in.desc: Vimala and her three sisters run a theatre called Maharaja Talkies. They get in trouble when Pappachan, a rich man, forces Vimala to shut down the theatre.

AsianetPlus.in.title: Goal
AsianetPlus.in.desc: Sam, a football player, gets admission in a prestigious international school under sports quota. His life changes for the better when he falls in love with a girl from the same school.

AsianetPlus.in.title: Nagarangalil Chennu Raparkam
AsianetPlus.in.desc: Conflicts arise between the heir to a wealthy rural family and his overprotective father. However, hilarity ensues after the heir runs away to the city and gets involved in a series of mishaps.
